has commenced an underwritten public offering of its common stock.
The company said all shares in the proposed offering will be sold by Teknova
Underwriters have a 30-day option to purchase up to an additional 15% of the shares offered.

Net proceeds from the offering will be used for general corporate purposes, including potentially the repayment of outstanding debt obligations. The company also stated it may use a portion of the proceeds to acquire or invest in other businesses, products, or technologies complementary to its own, but that it has no current commitments or arrangements to do so.

title: Teknova files for equity offering, shares down 22%
